lead_time.note: Days from a timestamp to 00:00 of the meeting day (an underestimate: most NY town boards meet 6-7:30 pm). Only CivicPlus AgendaCenter 'Posted' stamps are first-posting times. CivicClerk publishOn and Revize '?t=' upload stamps are LAST (re)publish times: many fall after the meeting (agenda re-uploaded with resolutions/minutes), so they bound posting only when they precede it. pdf_proxy is the PDF's ModDate/CreationDate (when the file was last saved). first_seen_upcoming is our own first fetch, upcoming meetings only (bounded by when this pilot ran, not by the town).
